reasoning: Tomato leaf with numerous small (<3mm) dark brown-black spots with visible yellow halos, scattered across the leaf surface. This pattern (small discrete spots + yellow halos) is the classic presentation of Bacterial Speck of Tomato caused by Pseudomonas syringae pv. tomato. Septoria spots would have pale centers; Early Blight spots would be larger with concentric rings; TSWV would show bronzing and ring necrosis rather than discrete dark spots.
